description: Address 3 critical review issues: getUserMedia mobile detection, Leaflet crash guard, and loading overlay
steps: Step 1 - Fix getUserMedia detection to use mobile UA check instead of pure capability detection, so mobile users get native camera picker
Step 2 - Guard initLocation() and openMapModal() against Leaflet CDN failure with typeof L check
Step 3 - Add loading overlay that displays while CDN scripts load and is removed when initApp() runs
acceptance_criteria: Camera button uses UA-based mobile detection to decide between getUserMedia modal and native file input
initLocation() gracefully handles missing Leaflet library without crashing
openMapModal() shows an alert and returns if Leaflet is not available
A loading overlay with spinner is shown until initApp() runs
verification: grep for isMobile regex in camera button handler
grep for typeof L === 'undefined' in initLocation and openMapModal
grep for appLoader in HTML body and in initApp function
Verify HTML structure is valid (balanced tags)
findings: All 3 review issues addressed: (1) getUserMedia now gated behind UA-based mobile detection so mobile users get native camera picker, (2) initLocation and openMapModal guarded with typeof L check to prevent crash if Leaflet CDN fails, (3) loading overlay added that shows spinner until initApp runs. JS braces verified balanced (244/244). HTML div tags balanced (77/77).
